open_points.subject: try an implementation
open_points.text: “try an implementation | agent | trial evidence per case” does not say which trial cases the action executes
open_points.question: Does an explicit try execute the whole current corpus, one named case, or a caller-selected subset?
options: Execute every trial case in the contract version’s current corpus
Execute one trial case named by the caller
Execute a caller-selected subset of the corpus
open_points.default_guess: Execute every trial case in the current corpus.

open_points.subject: try an implementation
open_points.text: “an empty corpus refuses” is stated for admission, but no outcome is stated for an explicit try when the contract version has no trial cases
open_points.question: Does an explicit try against an empty corpus refuse, or succeed while creating no TrialExecution records?
options: Refuse the try because there are no cases
Return an empty evidence set and create no TrialExecution records
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the try because there are no cases.

open_points.subject: run a flow
open_points.text: The run action says that a missing active flow or function activation “creates no run,” while M21 calls a run input a validated StoredValue, but the texts do not say whether invalid, missing or extra flow inputs create a Run
open_points.question: When supplied flow inputs do not fit the active flow version’s input ports, is the request refused before a Run is minted, or is a failed Run and trace created?
options: Validate all flow inputs first and refuse without creating a Run
Create a Run that ends failed with a trace describing the input violation
Create the Run and let each consuming node record a contract violation
open_points.default_guess: Validate all flow inputs first and refuse without creating a Run.

open_points.subject: cancel a run and EffectAttempt
open_points.text: “a finished run cannot be cancelled” permits cancelling a running run, and cancellation means “nothing further is sent,” but M26 permits an EffectAttempt to be `in_flight`; the texts do not state what cancellation does when a request has already been sent and has not concluded
open_points.question: When cancellation arrives while an EffectAttempt is in flight, when does the Run become `cancelled`, and may that attempt later transition to `applied`, `not_applied` or `unknown`?
options: Cancel the Run immediately, send nothing else, and still record the eventual outcome of the already-sent attempt
Wait for the in-flight attempt to conclude, then cancel the Run
Serialize requests so cancellation cannot be processed until the in-flight invocation has concluded
open_points.default_guess: Cancel the Run immediately, prevent further sends, and allow the already-sent attempt’s eventual outcome to be recorded.
